title: Seniors citizens can be only allowed one type of discount — SC

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A hotel manager in Bacolod City has been acquitted of violating the Senior Citizens, as the Supreme Court ruled on Wednesday that discounts accorded to elderly is not absolute as they could not be combined with other promos when availing goods and services. The high court stated during Wednesday’s en banc session […]... Keep on reading: Seniors citizens can be only allowed one type of discount — SC
